name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub mirrors the consumed contract surface of the dsh-private packages/util/timeout seam (TimeoutReason, Deadline, deadline signal fusion, timeoutOf classification) and implements just enough behavior for real-composition tests. Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
